import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (invalid values)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (max allowed is 6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Fix sex case variant: FEMALE -> female
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace('FEMALE', 'female')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
